items.claim: Crossings at a graph vertex cost nothing

items.note: The router reseeds after an undo, redo or history jump. Undo inside an open journal and `scene.replay` are not covered, because they don't reach `scene.history.observe`.

items.claim: A cancelled drag's previews come back when a later drag runs out of budget
items.note: on top of e781181ee1. Core's `TransformFollower` gets an optional `begin()`, called once when a move, resize or rotate drag starts. The avoid follower uses it to call the new `AvoidRouter.beginPreview()`.

items.claim: The follower's `still` shortcut serves the last drag's previews on a new drag's first frame
The spec router skips self-loops with both ports named
The spec router files no obstacle for a split connector's label
items.note: A split edge built from specs keeps router `bezier`, not `avoid`, so `avoidSceneInput` doesn't file its label either; the two readers agree. Its label pose in specs is also a placeholder until the scene derives it.

items.claim: The spec router routes through cluster boxes
A moved label is matched against routes by `clearance` instead of `labelClearance`
A locked connector's refused route is recorded as held, so it never reroutes after unlock
items.note: Adds `AvoidRouter.forget(ids)`. While a connector stays locked, every edit that disturbs it reroutes it again and the write is refused again.

items.claim: The routeEdge window loop never ends on a non-finite limit
items.note: Both halves are fixed: the loop stops once the window overflows, and `limitOf` skips coordinates that aren't finite.
Fewer than two shapes now throws.

items.claim: The full-route bench reports only the last run's unrouted count
A pathless connector's fallback line skips its waypoints
`createAvoidRouter` grew past the 120-line function cap with the new methods
items.note: (moved the drag-frame loop into its own function)

items.claim: This round's changeset titles were over the 140-character limit
